nodes.label: C# vehicle demo programs (Kraz, HMMWV, UAZBUS, Gator, CRGTerrain)
nodes.rationale: Nearly all C# vehicle demos require VSG (not Irrlicht) for run-time visualization; only demo_CS_VEH_paths builds on postprocess alone. Kraz_ClosedLoop additionally needs postprocess and CRGTerrain_VSG needs OpenCRG.

nodes.label: OpenCRG dynamic-object C# reference workaround
nodes.rationale: CRGTerrain demos use C# dynamic objects, which require the Microsoft.CSharp assembly reference on Windows/MSVC. On Unix the build instead requires the Mono package, and the comment marks that path as currently untested. This identical block is duplicated verbatim in the vehicle, sensor and ros C# demo CMakeLists.
